_doc: Per-model TensorRT build config. The build-engine entrypoint (app/entrypoint.sh) looks up MODEL_NAME here to decide trtexec precision. Default for an unlisted model (or if this file is missing) is fp32 — keeps legacy pig (my_model, imgsz=640) at FP32/30 FPS. imgsz=1280 models use fp16 (~15 FPS on Jetson Orin Nano). imgsz is informational (the engine matches the ONNX input size); precision is the only field the entrypoint acts on.
